findings.fix: Panels sit on the ground: separate them with a fill one step from the ground or a quiet 1px border. A shadow, if any, is under 8% black with a small blur. Real overlays (menus, dialogs, popovers) may float.

findings.message: 12 panel borders are dark against their ground: #906137 on #fdf0d8 (4.72:1) | #c1ae91 on #fdf0d8 (1.91:1) | #c1ae91 on #fdf0d8 (1.91:1)
findings.fix: A panel border is a whisper: about 1.1–1.3:1 against its ground on a light screen (#e5e7eb–#ededed on white), and about 1.2–1.5:1 on a dark one (#1a1a1a on #000, #2e2e2e on #111). Darker lines turn the screen into a grid of boxes; keep the stronger line for controls.

findings.fix: Keep the screen neutral and spend colour on data and status: the studied screens sit near 3%, and only tinted styles reach 10–15%, as pale tints rather than saturated fills.
